proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellCommandRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The Command spell cast through this wand is restricted to the 'flee' or 'grovel' option only. The current grant_spell_access surface has no field to restrict which sub-option/command word a spell may use when cast. Without this, the encoding implies the wand can issue any Command, which is incorrect.

notes: Primary mechanics (charge pool, two spells at different charge costs, fixed DC 15, 60-ft cone area override for Fear, dawn reset, last_charge_roll destruction) all fit the existing surface cleanly — identical pattern to Wand of Fireballs extended to two spells. The Command restriction to 'flee' or 'grovel' is the sole unrepresentable secondary mechanic; it is a new variant on grant_spell_access, not a missing v4 atom.
